<a id="op-databasehealth-getdatabasehealth"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/DatabaseHealth`

operationId `DatabaseHealth_GetDatabaseHealth` · Retrieves comprehensive database health statistics including message counts grouped by status and dataflow
This endpoint is designed for monitoring and administrative purposes

This endpoint executes: SELECT COUNT(*), Status, DataFlowId FROM Messages GROUP BY Status, DataFlowId
Results include friendly names for statuses and dataflows for better readability.

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [GetDatabaseHealthResponse](#schema-getdatabasehealthresponse) | Health statistics retrieved successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - requires Admin role or specific permissions |
| `500` | — | Internal server error |
